The output is stuck near the low side of its range with almost no gain, which points to the tail current being inconsistent with the PMOS load currents. The tail mirror M5 (W/L = 50.32/1, a 25× ratio to M0) sets about 251 uA. The PMOS loads M3/M4 (28.63/0.3 against Mb2's 1.396/0.3) carry only about 43 uA each, so the tail can't be supplied. The measured 150 uW (about 83 uA from VDD) also fits roughly 86 uA of branch current, not 251 uA. The input pair and loads are forced out of saturation, which would explain the gain collapse and the low output DC. Mb5 is the next most likely culprit, because its small W sets the NMOS cascode gate bias and an undersized sink would pull vout low. M3 is the third candidate.
